description: This file contains unit tests for the absl::FixedArray container, including tests for constructors, copy/move semantics, element access, comparison operators, iterator behavior, memory allocation, and sanitizer annotations.

classes.name: ConstructionTester
classes.description: Helper class to test object construction and destruction within FixedArray.

classes.name: ThreeInts
classes.description: Class with three integer members initialized with a static counter, used to test initialization of non-trivial types.

methods.name: IsOnStack
methods.description: Helper template function to determine if a FixedArray is allocated on the stack based on its size.

methods.name: ConstructionTester::CheckConstructed
methods.description: Checks if the object was properly constructed.
